verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Sovereign in the mountain air
Sovereign on the ocean floor
With me in the calm
With me in the storm

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Sovereign in my greatest joy
Sovereign In my deepest cry
With me in the dark
With me at the dawn

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
In Your everlasting arms
All the pieces of my life
From beginning to the end
I can trust You

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
In Your never failing love
You work everything for good
God, whatever comes my way
I will trust You

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
All my hopes
All I need
Held in Your hands

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
All my life
All of me
Held in Your hands

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
All my fears
All my dreams
Held in Your hands
